front: Knock an item out of a creature's grasp or weaken its hold, with Athletics against its Reflex DC.
back:
Athletics vs. Reflex DC.
Crit Success: item falls to the ground in target's space.
Success: weaken its grasp: further Disarm attempts on that item get +2 circumstance bonus, and target takes -2 circumstance penalty to attacks with it or other checks needing a firm grip. It can end this by Interacting to change grip; otherwise lasts while it holds the item.
Crit Failure: you're off-guard until the start of your next turn.
